## Orientation

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/area-levels--fix-area-levels-review` on task branch `task/area-levels/fix-area-levels-review`.
Other tasks in this wave run in their own worktrees. Do not touch them.
Do not edit anything under `.canon/`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R1: `#/` shows the product index with one card for each area.
R14: `GET /api/areas` lists, for each area, the promoted ideas whose effort is placed in that area.
R18: `#/effort/<name>` shows the Home screen of that effort.

## Approach

Fix four review findings. Frontend commands run in `dashboard/frontend`. Write each test first and see it fail on an assertion. Name each vitest test so it starts with the requirement id and a space. Do not edit `src/deepLinks.test.ts`, `src/detail.test.ts`, `src/detailNav.test.ts` or the frozen `tests/dashboard/test_areas_promoted.py`. Do not add comments that explain a change.

1. R18, finding `review-area-levels-close-fallback`. Journal Back (`close-journal` in `src/lib/screens/Journal.svelte`), the Esc handler in `src/App.svelte`, and the empty-stack fallback of `closeDetail` in `src/detail.ts` call `openHash("")`. That now opens the product index. Make them return to the effort page of the selected effort (`effortHref(...)`), and to `#/` only when no effort is selected. `detail.ts` must not import the polling state (polling imports detail); pass the fallback href from the caller or read it through a small parameter. Write `src/lib/screens/closeFallback.test.ts` with tests named `R18 ...`: a deep link `#/task/<id>` closed with Esc, and a journal Back, each end on `#/effort/<name>`. Keep the existing overlay and back-stack tests passing.
2. R1, finding `review-area-levels-areas-guard`. In `src/lib/state/areas.svelte.ts` (`bindAreas`) set `areas.error` to a short message when the `/api/areas` response is not an array, and keep `areas.items` empty. Write `src/lib/state/areasGuard.test.ts` with a test named `R1 a response that is not a list sets the areas error`. If an existing unchanged test needs an `/api/areas` stub, fix production code or a test other than the four protected files. Check that `npm test` still passes; the existing stubs that answer every URL with the snapshot must not crash the app (the error must show only on screens that read `areas.error`).
3. R14, finding `review-area-levels-empty-placement`. In `dashboard/backend/areas.py` `_home_area`: when the placement for the effort has an empty area, fall back to the idea's own `area`. Write `tests/dashboard/test_areas_placement_edge.py` with test names starting `test_r14_`, using the same CLI helpers and fixtures as `tests/dashboard/test_areas_promoted.py` (copy the small helpers; do not edit that file). A placement cannot hold an empty `area` through the CLI if the schema requires a ref, so build the case by calling `_home_area` directly with a placement map that holds an empty area.
4. Finding `review-area-levels-weak-r6-test`. Delete `test_r6_product_index_shows_area_cards_with_open_idea_counts` from `tests/dashboard/test_areas.py`. The vitest R5 test covers the behavior.

Run before you finish: `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm test` in `dashboard/frontend`; `uv run pytest tests/dashboard/test_areas.py tests/dashboard/test_areas_promoted.py tests/dashboard/test_areas_placement_edge.py tests/dashboard/test_ui_structure.py -q`; `uvx ruff@0.13.1 check dashboard tests/dashboard`; `uv run basedpyright dashboard`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R1: `#/` shows the product index with one card for each area.
R14: `GET /api/areas` lists, for each area, the promoted ideas whose effort is placed in that area.
R18: `#/effort/<name>` shows the Home screen of that effort.

### Design / decisions (quote)

Invariants:
- Hash routing only. One served document.
- The product index and the area page write nothing.
- An idea never renders among the efforts.
- The URL decides the selected effort.

Assumptions:
- Phase `effort-area-link` is merged, so `area` is on every snapshot effort.
- The Home screen needs no change other than the chip.
- The Playwright seed store can hold an area and a placement.

Decisions:
- landing-product-index: #/ shows the product index, one card for each area; the effort Home moves to #/effort/<name>
- area-join-client-side: Group efforts in the browser from the snapshot; the backend adds promoted ideas to the area of their effort's placement
